project_name: IzognMovies: African On-Demand Movie Streaming Platform
project_description: IzognMovies is a web-based streaming platform delivering African movies on demand to a global audience. Customers can register, browse, search, and purchase movies via credit card or pre-paid cards, streaming content within a 2-day viewing window. The platform supports subscription and pay-as-you-go monetization models. Administrators can manage movie catalogs, generate pre-paid cards, handle customer accounts, and access business analytics. A review functionality is also included. The design emphasizes accessibility for novice internet users through an African-inspired modern aesthetic, while maintaining robust security for customer and payment data.

selected_requirements.text: System shall let customers register on the website as a "pay as you go" user in under 5 minutes.'
System shall let customers register on the website as a "unlimited movie subscriber" user in under 10 minutes.'
'System shall let existing customers log into the website with their email address and password in under 5 seconds.'
'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'
'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'
'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'
'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'
When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'
